title: Duality exchanges pivotal outputs
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $x$ be a point of the cube. The Boolean dual of $f$ is pivotal at coordinate $i$ with output $-1$ at the point obtained by negating every coordinate of $x$ if and only if $f$ is pivotal at coordinate $i$ with output $1$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
A point $x$ of the Boolean cube
